svg.title: Control evidence state machine
svg.text: Evidence status of one control: how new observations change what pricing sees
PASS [strength ≥ best], e.g. fix seen by agent
Resolution rule: among a control's ACTIVE observations, the highest evidence strength wins; a tie goes to the most recent.
So a later questionnaire "yes" (DECLARED) cannot hide an agent FAIL (TECHNICALLY_OBSERVED). Before bind the status prices the
risk at the next quote; after bind it only drives warranties (B3).
Multipliers (Marsh 2023: relative risk S, adoption p)
Gate: a warranty passes only when VERIFIED;
MFA also passes when STATED (it cannot
• Questionnaire says EDR yes → STATED. The fleet roll-up then reports EDR PASS on ≥ 95 % of hosts → VERIFIED.
• One host's EDR stops and the fleet drops below 95 % → NOT_WORKING. A later questionnaire "yes" changes nothing.
• Backups: the fleet can see a recent backup but not a restore test, so a pass arrives as PARTIAL → STATED.
